Arabic: يا ليل طوّل ساعاتك...يا ليل أحمل آهاتك
English: O night prolong your hours! O night I carry you pains!

Once I bid my guardians farewell
My enemies will capture me!

Arabic: طول ياليل الوداع اشما تطول اوياك أساهر
English: Prolong yourself O night of the farewell! As long as you take I will remain awake

Arabic: ما أمل من البواجي حتى لو تعمه النواظر
English: I will continue to cry until I become blind

Arabic: احسين بس هالليلة يمي ما تشوفه اعيوني باجر
English:
This is my last night with Hussain
and tomorrow my eyes will no longer see him [after his killing]

Arabic: صدقني يا ليل القهر...يا ريتك اطّول دهر
English:
Believe me O night of pain and disturbance
I wish you could be prolonged until the end of time [in this world]

Arabic: خايفة من أشباح القدر...و أخاف أضل مكسوره خاطر
English:
I fear the shadows of the decree
And I fear I will always be heartbroken
O night have mercy on my heart! O night my dreams have been shattered!

O the pain I feel from the treacherous [people of my] era
My enemies will capture me!

Arabic: يا ليل طوّل ساعاتك...يا ليل أحمل آهاتك
English: O night prolong your hours! O night I carry you pains!

Once I bid my guardians farewell
My enemies will capture me!

Arabic: آنه ياليل العقيله زينب المعروف خدري
English:
O night I am Al-Aqeelah
Zainab the one whose hijab is known

Arabic: طولي ماواحد الشافه اولاستر يوصل الستري
English:
Never has a stranger seen my height
And there is no Hijab like mine!

Arabic: لجن ياليل اشبدية سلمت للقدر أمري
English:
However O night what can I do?
I have left my affairs to Allah!

Arabic: دمعاتي يبسن بالجفن...من يطر مصباح الحزن
English:
My tears have dried on my cheeks
When the lantern of sadness will be lighted

I will be tested with [the protection of] children and a family
I swear by Allah my patience cannot be withstood [by people]

O night! Enough! Stop terrifying me!
O night! The mourning that comes after you will devastate me

If they go down to the battlefield
My enemies will capture me!
